summary: Arman "Jack" Qureshi, 22, fled Steamboat Springs police during a disturbance-call response and jumped into the Yampa River near Yampa Street around midnight; an officer entered the river attempting to save him; a multi-agency search (Steamboat Police, Routt County SO, Steamboat Fire Rescue, West Routt Fire, CPW boats, Routt County SAR, Classic Air helicopter ~2 hrs) recovered his body downriver near the Steamboat Golf Club; drowning fatality.
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Steamboat Springs Police Department; Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: Run 1002 insert; Police1 article published 2017-06-09 ("May 22 foot pursuit that ended with the drowning"; RCSAR IC Del Bostock + Classic Air helicopter on the search). Recovery-day variant noted: the Pilot reports the body found Monday afternoon (May 22); Police1 reports recovery the following day (May 23) — row dated by the occurrence (May 22). Scope: fleeing suspect, but RCSAR + Classic Air deployed on the river search/recovery — indexed per the id-2880 fleeing-subject precedent (warrants subject found by SARDOC dog, indexed).
